newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai firm IBC to raise capital.
newsitem.headline: Thai firm IBC to raise capital.

text.p: International Broadcasting Corp, Thailand's major pay-TV operator, said on Tuesday it would issue new eight million shares at 10 baht each (0.38 cents) and offer them to South Africa-based Multichoice International Holding Co Ltd.
International Broadcasting said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that the payment date was set for April 5.
International Broadcasting said its wholly paid-up registered captital would increase to 810 million baht from 730 million after the allocation of new shares to Multichoice International Holding.
The company said the increase in the capital would be used for investing and improving broadcasting and program production systems.
Multichoice International Holding is a major pay-TV group, covering operations in Europe, the Middle East and Africa, IBC said. ($1 = 26 baht)
